title: Intermittent occurrence reports and speed-limit confusion
summary: This topic groups brief reports of intermittent issues, limited reproducibility details, and one note about confusion with adaptive speed-limit behavior.

negative.summary: The negative feedback describes a problem occurring at both operating limits without further detail on the failure mode.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined feedback mainly records customer statements about when an issue occurs, difficulty specifying timing or frequency, troubleshooting plans, and confusion about adaptive speed-limit following.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined customer statements with too little context to identify a specific defect or outcome.
The cluster mixes intermittent occurrence reports, charging or preconditioning context, delay timing uncertainty, and adaptive speed-limit confusion rather than one clearly unified issue.
The sample is small and sentiment is mostly undetermined, so concrete aspect coverage is limited.
